Recorded decisions

DEC-001 · accepted

All construction trades

Source to verified estimate with count, length, area and volume. Proven trade packs extend neutral contracts; fencing is optional.

DEC-002 · accepted

Routine defaults

Keep the existing visual system. AUD. Local-first browser and Windows x64. Authentication and database remain off.

DEC-003 · accepted

Proof before verified

Fresh patch and executed proof, screenshots where meaningful, and independent reviewer approval. Imported historical completion labels are not trusted proof.

DEC-004 · accepted

One canonical ledger writer

Root orchestrates only. Assigned agents write bounded handovers; only the assigned ledger writer edits planning/control/ledger.json. No dashboard status mutation.

DEC-005 · exception-recorded

Runtime audit thread reuse

Parent reports two fresh-agent spawn attempts rejected by the thread limit; retained audit_engine_release is reused only for startup/runtime baseline. Its startup packet, not old conversation, is authoritative.

DEC-006 · accepted

Independent host compatibility entry gate

Parent assigns existing CLI protocol reproduction to iw_sc02_contract independently of unverified neutral contracts. Removed IW004 dependency for this bounded compatibility task only; final desktop/release milestones retain their dependencies. Temporarily paused for contract reviewer fixes.

DEC-007 · accepted

Visible local screenshot proof is mandatory

User correction: screenshot proof belongs visibly IN THE HTML. Every task needs embedded captured local evidence with provenance; UI before/after desktop/mobile, non-UI execution report explicitly distinct from app behavior plus raw logs. Gallery implementation belongs to audit_engine_release and requires separate independent approval. Prior unit checks do not close gallery or product work.

DEC-008 · accepted

Separate gallery authorship and bounded runtime entry

Independent reviewer became gallery implementer after explicit user correction; IW023 requires independent review by another agent. IW004 bounded core has passing independent execution but canonical approval waits gallery review. IW022 leaves command/persistence integration queued. IW005 uses existing UI source independently of new core runtime; parent-inspected baseline reproduction and core readiness establish entry without falsely verifying whole slices.

DEC-009 · accepted

Bounded gallery approval and runtime entry

IW023 independently approved by iw_sc02_contract at exact source hashes; root visually approved. IW001 composite tracker state remains awaiting approval; IW004 legacy transitive domain/calibration dependencies need stable rerun before full core acceptance. IW022 can implement direct contract/lifecycle-based runtime independently of legacy adapter; no claim of whole core/slice completion.

Nothing silently dropped
